items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 23:1
items.html: Aba is hinted at in the Yod of HaVaYaH, and Ima is hinted at in the Vav-Dalet of the spelling of Yod. And the reason for this is that Ima is concealed and clothed within Aba, and only the phase of Aba alone is in revelation; therefore the phase of Ima is not revealed in the letters of the name HaVaYaH, only in the spelling alone. And see below, answer 111. (Item 890, item 42)
